title: Soft Glam vs Full Glam: Which Bridal Look Is Right for You?
excerpt: Choosing between soft glam and full glam sets the entire tone of your bridal look — here's how to decide which style suits you best.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, neutral tones, and feathery lashes for a timeless, effortlessly romantic finish that photographs beautifully in natural light. Full glam, on the other hand, delivers bold contour, dramatic lashes, and a polished intensity perfect for grand ballroom celebrations. At Velora Bella, we help every Fort Lauderdale bride find the balance that honors her personality, venue, and vision.
